Answer: C
Reason: Comparing Figure 1a (pre-op) and Figure 3a (post-op), the mediastinal silhouette remains similarly widened without significant reduction in size, which argues against successful removal or complete resolution; this persistence of a mass-like opacity shortly after surgery is most consistent with a post-surgical hematoma rather than immediate tumor recurrence or residual disease. *(guided by t000009)*
